findings.title: Team admins must also be owners to add guests
findings.body: This combines `isTeamAdmin` and `isTeamOwner` with `&&`, so a team member must satisfy both checks to pass this branch. Admins and owners are distinct roles, so ordinary team admins are denied access despite the intended admin-or-owner permission. Use an OR between the role checks.

findings.title: Guest filtering is case-sensitive
findings.body: Email addresses are compared verbatim against existing attendees and against a blacklist whose entries are lowercased. A differently-cased address can therefore bypass the blacklist and be added as a duplicate of an existing attendee; email addresses are case-insensitive in practice. Normalize both submitted addresses and stored/blacklisted addresses before filtering.
